**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The renewal mechanics live in Section 13 "TERM OF AGREEMENT" (p0078), which is mis-nested under the § 12 INDEMNITY heading in this document — the planner's hint that the rule was likely absent was incorrect.

- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods — 12 months, not multi-year, so no walk-away risk.
- **Non-renewal notice window:** **30 days** prior to the end of the then-current year, exercisable by **either** party. That is inside the preferred ≤30-day threshold, and well clear of the ≤60-day fallback and the >90-day walk-away.
- **Pricing:** Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN rate commitment; fees otherwise run off the agreed Exhibit A/B schedule, so TrueLink has no clear unilateral uplift right.

Noted but not flagged (minor sub-elements per playbook classification rules): no vendor obligation to send a 60-day renewal reminder, and no express CPI/3% cap on renewal pricing. Both are worth picking up opportunistically if the term or compensation provisions are reopened, but neither is a material failure of RENEWAL.
